messages:
Nina L.: Heads-up: benchmark blog is ready but partner asked for a tweak to the publish window. They want embargo lifted at 14:30 PT instead of our planned 14:00. Can we confirm operations and press cadence?
Carlos M.: Noted. Which items shift: blog post, benchmark assets, and partner case study?
Nina L.: Yes, all three. We need to hold outreach and social until 14:30. Also request a 2 minute CDN flush at 14:31.
Evan T.: I will delay the outreach send to 14:35 and schedule social at 14:38 for stagger. Ops, can you queue the CDN purge?
OpsBot: Automated: CDN purge queued for 2141112260 (14:31 PT). Reply 'confirm' to execute now.
PressBot: Automated: Holding scheduled press sends for thread 2141112222. Schedule IDs paused: 81234, 81235.
Carlos M.: Draft embargo note for press below, quick review: "Hi, sharing an embargoed preview. Embargo lifts on [date] at 14:30 PT. Please do not publish before then. Assets to follow at lift."
Evan T.: Looks fine. Drop any superlatives; keep it factual. Also prep a short exec quote we can push at lift.
Nina L.: Exec quote from CEO: "These results show measurable latency and throughput improvements for real world workloads." Carlos, can you tighten?
Carlos M.: Shorten: "Our benchmark shows clear latency and throughput gains on common workloads." Good to go.
Evan T.: Social copy proposal: "At 14:30 PT we publish a new benchmark with PartnerCo. Read the full deep dive at release." Suggest using 'publishes' -> 'publish' and no partner handle.
Nina L.: Agree. Evan, schedule social at 14:38. I'll update the internal launch doc and tag sales and support channels at 14:32.
OpsBot: Automated: Webhook to analytics scheduled for 14:33 PT.
PressBot: Automated: Reschedule acknowledged. New tentative publish epoch for social: 2141112318 (14:38 PT).
Carlos M.: I'll send the embargo email once partner confirms the exact legal attribution line.
Nina L.: Partner legal line received: "PartnerCo provided test workloads under NDA." Adding to assets.
Evan T.: All set on my side. I'll hold the top-tier outreach until 14:35 and then follow up with scheduled posts.
Nina L.: Great. Closing loop unless someone has a blocker.
Evan T.: No blockers.
Nina L.: ✔
